Flag packages that collect and exfiltrate host data or poll remote servers for executable payloads. Use static analysis to detect XOR/hex/Base64 decryption routines and dynamic analysis to catch delayed or multi-stage execution. Watch for network connections to known C2 domains/IPs and unusual HTTP POSTs from development environments. Correlate presence of hidden modules and suspicious function names with behavioral indicators for high-confidence detection.
